positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer for real-time simulation software developed in C++ for Linux and Windows platforms using an Agile development environment.
Developed installers and user manuals for products developed in-house. Responsible for design, development and technical support of software products for use at multiple locations. 
Derived software requirements from system specifications.
Developed automated test framework for requirements verification and traceability.
Develop software using spiral development process in a SEI level 5 environment.
Developed real-time applications in C for VxWorks targets.
Comptia Secure+ certified.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed C based applications for embedded Unix platforms. Developed embedded applications in a SEI level 3 environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed DO-178B level B & level D embedded avionics applications in C and C++.
